pro_course_detail.title: Conversation, reading, pronunciation–or structured lessons for beginning, intermediate, or advanced levels,  general conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, for many students, I ask you if you had any issues using English this week or have any questions or requests. Then, I ask if you’d like to read something. I offer the New York Times, the Washington Post, the Straits Times (Singapore), or some easy English reading, or something related to your field of work or study, or from your location or that you request. As you read, I note any pronunciation errors, and when you read a paragraph or two, I tell you. Then, I ask if you understand everything and explain if needed. 

Then I bring up some vocabulary words. Usually the “dictionary definition” is on the screen. I ask if you know the word. If not, I explain the normal meaning and any social or cultural meaning of the word. Many students find this very helpful. Also, I keep a list of idoms and expressions in English, that I write down as I hear the or say them, in my daily life. Many students really enjoy this, and often, they have not heard the words used this way.

Then, if the student wishes, I have grammar quizzes I can offer on tenses, punctuation, and more grammar topics.
